    """
    Bubble Sort algorithm implementation.

    Args:
        arr (list[int]): The list of integers to be sorted.

    Returns:
        list[int]: The sorted list.
    """
    n = len(arr)
    for i in range(n):
        # Flag to check if any swap occurred
        swapped = False
        for j in range(0, n-i-1):
            if arr[j] > arr[j+1]:
                # Swap the elements
                arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j]

    return arr
